groups.title_zh: 仪器、设计与跨学科实践

tracks.summary_zh: 微积分、线性代数、微分方程、复变函数与数值思维，为后续所有建模和分析提供共同语言。
tracks.summary_en: Calculus, linear algebra, differential equations, complex variables, and numerical reasoning for modeling across EE.

tracks.summary_zh: 从概率模型到随机信号、估计与推断，连接通信、控制、信号处理和器件噪声。
tracks.summary_en: Probability models, random signals, estimation, and inference for communications, control, DSP, and device noise.

tracks.summary_zh: 力学、电磁学、波动与量子基础，面向机器人、场与波、器件和光电方向。
tracks.summary_en: Mechanics, electromagnetism, waves, and quantum foundations for robotics, fields, devices, and photonics.

tracks.summary_zh: Python、C、版本控制、可复现实验与数值工具，强调把分析变成可验证的软件。
tracks.summary_en: Python, C, version control, reproducible experiments, and numerical tools that turn analysis into verifiable software.

tracks.summary_zh: 用跨越电路、信号、计算和机电系统的综合课程建立全景认知，并尽早完成小型系统。
tracks.summary_en: Survey courses spanning circuits, signals, computation, and electromechanical systems, with early system-building practice.

tracks.summary_zh: 直流、交流、动态电路、网络定理和频域方法，是电子、控制、电力与仪器的共同基础。
tracks.summary_en: DC, AC, dynamic circuits, network theorems, and frequency-domain methods shared by electronics, control, power, and instrumentation.

tracks.summary_zh: 从面包板、示波器和误差分析到可复现实验报告，建立安全、可靠的动手能力。
tracks.summary_en: Breadboards, oscilloscopes, uncertainty, and reproducible lab reports for safe and reliable hands-on work.

tracks.summary_zh: 二极管、晶体管、运放、反馈、滤波与模拟系统设计，兼顾小信号模型和实际非理想因素。
tracks.summary_en: Diodes, transistors, op-amps, feedback, filters, and analog system design with real nonidealities.

tracks.summary_zh: 卷积、变换、采样、滤波和反馈的统一语言，贯通信号处理、通信与控制。
tracks.summary_en: Convolution, transforms, sampling, filtering, and feedback as a common language for DSP, communications, and control.

tracks.summary_zh: 组合逻辑、时序逻辑、有限状态机、处理器与存储层次，从门级抽象走向完整计算机。
tracks.summary_en: Combinational and sequential logic, finite-state machines, processors, and memory from gates to complete computers.

tracks.summary_zh: Maxwell 方程、边界条件、传输线、波导与辐射，为 RF、光子和高速互连奠基。
tracks.summary_en: Maxwell equations, boundaries, transmission lines, waveguides, and radiation for RF, photonics, and high-speed interconnects.

tracks.summary_zh: ISA、流水线、缓存、并行与性能分析，解释数字系统如何执行真实程序。
tracks.summary_en: ISAs, pipelines, caches, parallelism, and performance analysis for understanding how hardware executes programs.

tracks.summary_zh: RTL、验证、外设接口与软硬件协同，以可综合设计和板级演示作为验收。
tracks.summary_en: RTL, verification, interfaces, and hardware/software co-design with synthesizable designs and board-level demonstrations.

tracks.summary_zh: 裸机程序、外设、实时采样、通信和系统集成，要求可重复构建的硬件项目。
tracks.summary_en: Bare-metal software, peripherals, real-time sampling, communications, and integrated hardware projects.

tracks.summary_zh: 调度、时序分析、可靠性与物理闭环，关注任务错过截止期时系统会发生什么。
tracks.summary_en: Scheduling, timing analysis, reliability, and physical feedback with explicit treatment of missed deadlines.

tracks.summary_zh: 侧信道、故障攻击、可信执行与安全架构，在真实处理器和可验证威胁模型上学习。
tracks.summary_en: Side channels, fault attacks, trusted execution, and secure architecture using real processors and testable threat models.

tracks.summary_zh: 离散变换、滤波器、谱估计、多率系统与实现，以代码、数据和误差指标闭环。
tracks.summary_en: Discrete transforms, filters, spectral estimation, multirate systems, and implementations validated with code and metrics.

tracks.summary_zh: 调制、检测、信道、同步、链路预算与无线系统，从波形到端到端可靠通信。
tracks.summary_en: Modulation, detection, channels, synchronization, link budgets, and wireless systems from waveforms to reliable links.

tracks.summary_zh: 熵、容量、率失真与现代纠错码，给出通信与压缩的理论边界和构造方法。
tracks.summary_en: Entropy, capacity, rate-distortion, and modern error-correcting codes for both limits and constructions.

tracks.summary_zh: 状态空间、稳定性、频域设计、估计与最优控制，强调仿真、实验和模型失配。
tracks.summary_en: State space, stability, frequency-domain design, estimation, and optimal control with simulation and model mismatch.

tracks.summary_zh: 运动学、动力学、规划、感知和操控，通过仿真或实体平台完成可演示系统。
tracks.summary_en: Kinematics, dynamics, planning, perception, and manipulation through demonstrable simulated or physical systems.

tracks.summary_zh: 网络参数、匹配、噪声、接收机、微波电路和天线，明确仪器、频谱法规与功率安全。
tracks.summary_en: Network parameters, matching, noise, receivers, microwave circuits, and antennas with instrumentation, spectrum, and RF safety.

tracks.summary_zh: 载流子、结、MOS 与纳米结构，把量子和固体物理连接到可测量的器件特性。
tracks.summary_en: Carriers, junctions, MOS structures, and nanostructures connecting quantum and solid-state physics to measurable devices.

tracks.summary_zh: 从器件模型到晶体管级放大器和数字门，连接半导体物理、模拟和集成电路设计。
tracks.summary_en: From device models to transistor-level amplifiers and gates, linking semiconductor physics to analog and IC design.

tracks.title_zh: 模拟与混合信号集成电路
tracks.summary_zh: 偏置、增益级、反馈、噪声、数据转换与版图意识，以仿真和设计权衡为核心。
tracks.summary_en: Biasing, gain stages, feedback, noise, data conversion, and layout-aware tradeoffs validated in simulation.

tracks.title_zh: 数字 VLSI 与芯片设计
tracks.summary_zh: CMOS 逻辑、时序、功耗、物理设计与验证，区分开源流程和受限商业 EDA。
tracks.summary_en: CMOS logic, timing, power, physical design, and verification with explicit open-source versus restricted EDA paths.

tracks.summary_zh: 沉积、光刻、刻蚀、工艺集成和微机电设计；无洁净室时只做工艺计划、仿真和案例分析。
tracks.summary_en: Deposition, lithography, etching, process integration, and MEMS design using process plans and simulation when cleanrooms are unavailable.

tracks.summary_zh: 几何与波动光学、半导体光电器件、集成光子和量子光学，结合可复现的仿真设计。
tracks.summary_en: Geometric and wave optics, optoelectronic devices, integrated photonics, and quantum optics with reproducible simulation.

tracks.summary_zh: 变换器拓扑、磁性元件、调制与闭环控制；高压和大功率实验默认仿真或受监督。
tracks.summary_en: Converter topologies, magnetics, modulation, and feedback; high-voltage or high-power work defaults to simulation or supervision.

tracks.summary_zh: 潮流、故障、稳定性、电能质量和机电能量转换，兼顾模型与现实电网约束。
tracks.summary_en: Power flow, faults, stability, power quality, and electromechanical conversion grounded in real grid constraints.

tracks.summary_zh: 电化学储能、太阳能电池、系统建模与能量管理，明确电池、激光和高压安全边界。
tracks.summary_en: Electrochemical storage, solar cells, system modeling, and energy management with explicit battery, laser, and high-voltage safety.

tracks.summary_zh: 原理图、版图、制造文件、BOM、调试与设计评审，让电路从仿真走到可制造、可测试硬件。
tracks.summary_en: Schematics, layout, fabrication outputs, BOMs, debugging, and reviews that turn simulations into manufacturable hardware.

tracks.summary_zh: 传感机理、接口电路、校准、噪声和测量不确定度，要求给出可追溯的测试方法。
tracks.summary_en: Sensing mechanisms, interfaces, calibration, noise, and uncertainty with traceable test methods.

tracks.summary_zh: 生理信号、医学成像、仪器与患者安全；人体实验必须遵守伦理、隔离和监督要求。
tracks.summary_en: Physiological signals, medical imaging, and instrumentation with patient safety, ethics, isolation, and supervision.

tracks.summary_zh: 把需求、标准、架构、成本、安全、制造、测试和复盘合并为一个可复现、可演示的工程交付物。
tracks.summary_en: Requirements, standards, architecture, cost, safety, fabrication, testing, and postmortems combined into a reproducible engineering deliverable.
